By: Carol Albertyn Christie | Production

While Carte Blanche may be known for it's investigative prowess, we also are known for delving into extraordinary and bizarre life styles.
We have been the talk at many a coffee club in the office in the morning;
- did you see the man who dresses up as a baby?
- the woman who fatally stabbed her sister in a jealous rage and then won the beauty contest at Kroonstad prison,as part of their rehabilitation programme.
- Pretty Yende - what a voice.

In our 30 years we have interviewed incredible individuals who have walked a different trail. We reflect on some of these stories. Including, Jim Rose, Pretty Yende, Beaufort West Prostitutes, Man Baby, S&M, 50 Shades, Riel Trappers, Sick Nick, Animal Whisperer, Pantsula,Faith 47, Zapiro and UFOs.

30th Bizarre Script


Up sound

Devi
“What do older women say about the sex?”
“They say the sex is hot”

“We’re not out to make any particular statement.”

V/O
Carte Blanche has delighted audiences and delivered on its promise, You Have the Right TO SEE IT All.

“How much do you have? How much can you offer me?”

“Wat is dit? Dit is UFOs.”

V/O (end shot Devi with two naked men.

We have excelled over the decades to exposing the bare facts.
Known for pushing the envelope and going where angels often feared to tred, Carte Blanche has, over 30 years, made friends with the weird and the whacky and helped us understand even the most unusual of fetishes - from bondage rooms to big baby nurseries.

Baby Boo
This is a 40 year old man , he’s a husband and a father, and in his spare time, this is what he does to relax.

Up Sound
“Very few people have actually seen this side of me. “

Baby Boo belongs to the hidden world of adult babies, grown men and women in nappies and over sized baby grows, physically regress to infancy.

“It’s just an escape, instead of um taking to alcohol and drugs to make you feel better this is what I do to escape from the pressures of adult life.”

V/O
Businessman by day, Baby Boo even had a seamstress who made his baby grows for down time. For Derek, there was one with extra length.

“Actually a good fit for you.”
“This is suspicious isnt it.”
“And then you have your little panties that fit undereath it. “
“Little.These are massive.”


V/O
Not as massive as the sumo wrestlers in the Jim Rose Circus we featured in 1998, who made the earth shake as 350 kilograms of flesh collided.


“At the edinburgh festival they called it sick. In texas they shut it down, the wall street journals urged their readers not to miss it. This is the Jim Rose Circus.”

“This is the armenian rubber man, natures greatest mistake, look at that?”

V/O
It was a freak show - pushing the boundaries of entertainment.

“Jim.What about what we saw today, vacuum packing a sumo wrestler , I mean that’s quite a grotesque image? “
“Good”
“It is a bit bizarre you have to admit that?”
“Hell Les, it better be, it’s a circus.”

V/O Visuals of racing car on track, driver blindfolded
With presenters willing to do almost anything…

“This is going to be interesting”

V/O
From driving in a sports car with a blind folded mentalist…

“Are you sure that there are no holes here.” (referring to hood)

V/O
To discovering PRICKasso, the man who paints with his penis.

“Oh my Goodness”

V/O
And interviewing those who let it ALL hang out on the Hibiscus coast

“We went on a mission to discover more about the local naturist movement , it was an education, and not just in keeping form eye contact.”

“You’ve got to be very comfortable in your own body?”

“I sat under that bar and I would not move. It took me a good few hours, because one is not used to walking around without your clothes on.”

“When you attend meetings and people hear that you are from the Hibiscus Coast and they say Oh…”
“You’re the naked guys” Laughing

V/O
We may have uncovered the truth but we have also examined those who wish to unearth it.

V/O
Every year during during the dry months, Madagascans take part in commemorating family members who have passed on.

This ancient ritual is called the turning of the bones.

V/O
This literally means digging up the graves of your ancestors and honouring their memory with a celebratory feast.

Up Sound Aaaah

Now another custom is observed, jewelry from the body is removed and distributed among the family as momentoes. Bruno takes Papa Louis’s signet ring.

During the day Papa Louis and Mama Buc over see the party but always with someone keeping them company.After much eating and drinking and dancing, as the sun begins to set, its time to return the bodies to their grave.

“You can see all these people are happy. They are really happy. It’s a very good thing for Madagascar.”

And so the bones are laid to rest, at least until the spirits call again.

V/O
And from one dimension to another.

“They’ve seen them, they’ve filmed them but not everybody believes them.”
“Jacques there are ufo’s in the sky.
Jacques grabbed his video camera and ran outside.
“There are a lot. Look there. Wait behind the clouds .
Where the fuck are those things now?”
“And I started filming it and I saw these objects. I am familiar with aeroplanes. I realised that these weren’t conventional air craft.”
The Loubschers counted 8 – 10 triangular objects , switching to red and blue when stationary. They were moving in a northerly direction and Jacques managed to capture 5 minutes on video.

V/O
20 years ago this video was analysed by state of the art equipment at the time.
(Something technology changed?)

“That is the outline of the solid object.”
“Even though the objects over Graaf Reneit have been declared UFOs, it does not necessarily mean that they are alien spacecraft . So what are they and where have they come from? We can only speculate.


V/O
South Africans are not afraid to express themselves like internationally acclaimed street artist Faith 47 .

“Gone are the days of artists being harassed for painting on wallsand although the works are transient they are respected, like Faith’s detaining of the beast in Shanghai.”

V/O
And to a beast of a different kind, the literary sensation 50 Shades of Grey whipped over 40 million readers worldwide into a frenzy.

“BDSM was seen as dark and sadistic in the past, but now everyone is talking about being slapped and tickled.

“If you enjoyed a really tough massage pr a little bit of nibbling on your neck, you have now enjoyed BDSM.”

“It’s hot and the fastest selling papareback of all time.”

V/O
And it ignited a new sexual subculture with audiences.

“And I would read a few pages to my fiancee and both of us would actually get so aroused that we have to close the book and go to the bedroom.”

“Part of the reason why the book is so succesful is because it has forced us to ask what does emancipation really mean? Does it mean we have the power to ask for what we really want?”

V/O
And now to release some steam.

“Ironing is usually considered to be mundane and dreary but a group of extreme sport enthusiasts are taking it way beyond the crisp starched edge.”

“Hot off the press , extreme ironing is the newest way to smooth out domestic blues. For this enthusiast plummeting to earth is the best way to press the pleats.”

“I am the current world altitude extreme ironist. Ok that means I have ironed higher than anyone else on the planet and the other thing I am is the only dude to have done it naked.”


V/O
Ironing on the top of a car may seem idiotic but for them it is the purest form of their art.


“To wrap it up we asked these men of metal for a some practical advice.”

“Well two things you need. One is an iron and the other an ironing board,
the rest is up to you.”


Promo 2

Get reacquainted with some of the unforgettable characters to have graced our screens in three decades of Carte Blanche. Celebrating the Bizarre and Extraordinary.

“I’m not out to make any particular statement.”

Promo 1

Carte Blanche has exposed that special kind of special. From Madagascar’s turning of the bones, karoo ufos, natural nudists to our world champions of extreme ironing. 30 years of capturing the bizarre and the extraordinary.

Promo 3

“This man is a 40 year old man, he’s a husband ad a father and in his spare time this is what he does to relax.”
“Very few people have seen this side of me.”

Carte Blanche has delighted audiences and delivered on its promise, You Have the Right TO SEE IT All.

“I find clothes very restricting.”

Known for pushing the envelope and going where angels often feared to tred, Carte Blanche has, over 30 years, made friends with the weird and the whacky and kept our audience on tenter hooks.
